auth.title: Sign in
auth.description: Choose how you want to sign in.
auth.signInLead: We email you a 6-digit code. You never need a password.
auth.signUpLead: We email you a 6-digit code to check the address is yours. You never need a password.
auth.codeLeadEmail: We sent a 6-digit code to {identifier}. It works for 15 minutes.
auth.codeLeadUsername: We sent a 6-digit code to the email of {identifier}. It works for 15 minutes.
auth.codeHint: If it is not there, look in your spam folder.
auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} s.
auth.resent: We sent you a new code.
auth.changeIdentifier: Use a different email or username
auth.ageLead: We ask once, so what you see fits your age.
auth.permissionLabel: I have my parent's or guardian's permission to use LittleFounders
auth.ageTooYoung: LittleFounders starts at age 6. See you when you turn 6!
auth.ageTooOld: {age}? You would be the oldest founder in history. What is your real age?
auth.googleWaiting: Choose your Google account in the window that opened.

errors.identifier: That does not look like an email or a username.
errors.email: That does not look like an email.
errors.codeInvalid: That code did not work. Check the numbers, or ask for a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: That was too many tries with this code. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Wait a moment before you try again.
errors.permissionRequired: Ask your parent or guardian first, then tick the box.
errors.googleCancelled: You closed Google before signing in.
errors.googleFailed: Google could not sign you in. Try again.
errors.googleUnavailable: Google is not available right now. Use your email.
errors.generic: Something failed on our side. Try again in a moment.

notFound.title: We can't find this page
notFound.text: The link may be old or have a typo. Start again from the home page.
notFound.sceneAlt: Rho and Liruf kneel back to back with their heads low, sad that they cannot find the page.

unsubscribe.title: Stop the optional emails?
unsubscribe.text: You will stop getting the emails that are not about your account. The ones about your account, like sign-in codes, will still arrive.
unsubscribe.doneText: From now on we only write to you about your account.
unsubscribe.againText: You will get our optional emails again.
unsubscribe.invalidText: Open the link at the bottom of one of our emails again.
unsubscribe.error: We could not save that. Try again.
